menu.title: Foul Fowl: Fly, Flock, Forage, Fight
menu.quit_confirm: This is the door. One More Turn is a different button, and it appears after you have already won.
credits.1: For eXplorminate, with affection: a small galaxy, a finished evening, and the swans exactly as guilty as charged.
credits.2: No balance patch was applied to the swans. This was a decision.
menu.preset.tiny.name: Tiny
menu.preset.evening_standard.name: Evening Standard
menu.preset.evening_standard.sub: Twenty-four stars. One sitting. Bedtime intact if you are honest.
menu.preset.evening_standard.seats: Swans, one early-war bird, one schemer. Take one of those seats and the chair refills.
menu.toggle.seat_swans.tip: Checked by default. Unchecking it is a setting.
difficulty.nestling.name: Nestling
difficulty.nestling.tip: The AI is smaller, and polite about it. It will not come for you first. The card says -25% industry and research.
difficulty.flighted.name: Flighted
difficulty.flighted.tip: No gifts to either side. If you lose, it is yours.
difficulty.honk_admiral.name: Honk Admiral
difficulty.honk_admiral.tip: The AI receives the printed bonuses and may read your ship designs. Be angry at a number. The number is listed.
difficulty.lights_off_ledger.name: Lights-Off Ledger
difficulty.lights_off_ledger.tip: +40% industry, +40% research, +20% growth, your designs, your colonies, your fleets. Every modifier is printed. None of them are gentle.
race.swans.name: The Pale Supremacy
race.swans.pitch: Better than you at the thing you were about to do, and already bored of the demonstration.
race.pheasants.name: The Ringneck Warrant
race.pheasants.pitch: A victory lap that learned to file flight plans.
race.ducks.name: The Dabble League
race.ducks.pitch: If it has a shoreline, they have a rate card.
race.geese.name: The Marked Airspace
race.geese.pitch: They were here first. The property line was the honk.
race.owls.name: The Night Parliament
race.owls.pitch: They have read the tree. They are waiting on you to finish the tutorial.
race.penguins.name: The Pebble Throne
race.penguins.pitch: They already colonized the iceball you filtered out.
race.crows.name: The Open Murder
race.crows.leader: Keeper of the Cache, Kestra Nightcache
race.crows.pitch: Your tech is in circulation. They are the circulation.
race.chickens.name: The Pecking Order
race.chickens.leader: Prime Rooster Cluckett of the Ninth
race.chickens.pitch: Someone has to build the galaxy. They voted, by pecking, that it would be them.

special.old_nest.name: Old Nest
special.old_nest.tip: The first colony here is handed a low tech you do not have.
special.pretty_rocks.name: Pretty Rocks
special.pretty_rocks.tip: +5 credits a turn. Shiny, and annoyingly liquid.
special.rude_wealth.name: Rude Wealth
special.rude_wealth.tip: +10 credits a turn. The soil is showing off.
special.kind_soil.name: Kind Soil
special.spare_nest.name: Spare Nest
special.spare_nest.tip: The first colony starts at two pop.
special.yard_scrap.name: Yard Scrap
building.grand_nest.name: Grand Nest
building.grand_nest.tip: The capital. It counts for more than it should, and it knows.
building.the_yard.name: The Yard
building.boot_barracks.name: Boot Barracks
building.boot_barracks.tip: A garrison, and a slow refill of marines.
building.feed_hall.name: Feed Hall
building.feed_hall.tip: Food, from a building, if the climate will not.
building.research_roost.name: Research Roost
building.horizon_perch.name: Horizon Perch
building.horizon_perch.tip: Three launchers of whatever you currently believe in.
building.colony_mantle.name: Colony Mantle
building.colony_mantle.tip: A shield for the nest. Bombardment is halved.
building.richer_dirt.name: Richer Dirt
building.richer_dirt.tip: Farmers, fed better by the dirt itself.
building.second_clutch.name: Second Clutch
building.second_clutch.tip: Growth, up by half, on this colony.
building.tireless_picks.name: Tireless Picks
building.tireless_picks.tip: Robots. They do not call in sick, and they do not start religions.
building.loud_abacus.name: Loud Abacus
building.loud_abacus.tip: Scientists, plus a machine that interrupts them productively.
building.more_perch.name: More Perch
building.more_perch.tip: One more pop per size, on this world.
building.talon_batteries.name: Talon Batteries
building.talon_batteries.tip: Four heavy Talons, aimed by a planet.
building.seed_exchange.name: Seed Exchange
building.gravity_manners.name: Gravity Manners
building.gravity_manners.tip: The gravity penalty on this world packs up and leaves.
building.night_lab.name: Night Lab
building.night_lab.tip: Ten research, whether or not anyone is on shift.
building.climate_lever.name: Climate Lever
building.ugly_perch.name: Ugly Perch
building.ugly_perch.tip: A gun platform with a shield. Ships built here cost less.
building.flock_brain.name: Flock Brain
building.flock_brain.tip: Scientists here, up by two each.
building.storm_mantle.name: Storm Mantle
building.deep_scratch.name: Deep Scratch
building.second_shift_hall.name: Second Shift Hall
building.second_shift_hall.tip: The night crew does not care about your narrative arc.
building.roost_gate.name: Roost Gate
building.roost_gate.tip: One turn between any two gates you own. The map does not grow a road.
building.departure_roost.name: Departure Roost
building.departure_roost.tip: The door out. Starting it is announced. Finishing it is the victory.
filler.trade_goods.name: Trade Goods
filler.trade_goods.tip: Converts half of industry output into credits.
filler.research_project.name: Research Project
filler.research_project.tip: Converts half of industry output into research.
notify.starvation: The granary is a rumour. {place} is losing people.
notify.strike: The treasury hit the floor. Industry sulks next turn.
